description: Implementation of the F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) for the DU component, including message handling, procedures, and logging.

classes.name: f1ap_du_impl::tx_pdu_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: A notifier class that logs outgoing F1AP messages before forwarding.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection to CU control plane and sets up message notifier with optional logging.

methods.name: disconnect_from_cu_cp
methods.description: Handles disconnection from CU control plane asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Processes F1 setup requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_f1_removal_request
methods.description: Processes F1 removal requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_f1_reset_request
methods.description: Processes F1 reset requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_du_config_update
methods.description: Handles DU configuration update requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation_request
methods.description: Handles UE creation requests and logs success or failure.

methods.name: handle_ue_configuration_request
methods.description: Handles UE configuration requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_deletion_request
methods.description: Removes UE context and updates metrics.

methods.name: handle_reset
methods.description: Schedules a reset procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_gnb_cu_configuration_update
methods.description: Schedules GNB-CU configuration update procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_setup_request
methods.description: Schedules UE context setup procedure, handling UE ID mapping.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_release_command
methods.description: Schedules UE context release procedure, handling UE ID and cause.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_modification_request
methods.description: Handles UE context modification requests.

methods.name: handle_dl_rrc_message_transfer
methods.description: Processes downlink RRC message transfer, including UE context lookup and forwarding.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_release_request
methods.description: Prepares and sends UE context release request message.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_modification_required
methods.description: Handles UE context modification confirmation asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Dispatches incoming F1AP messages based on PDU type.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Processes various initiating F1AP messages.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Handles successful outcomes of procedures, matching transaction IDs.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Handles unsuccessful outcomes of procedures, matching transaction IDs.

methods.name: handle_rx_message_gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Validates and updates gNB-CU UE F1AP ID, sending error if mismatch.

methods.name: send_error_indication
methods.description: Constructs and sends an error indication message.

methods.name: handle_paging_request
methods.description: Processes paging requests, sending error if handling fails.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_request
methods.description: Schedules positioning measurement procedures.

methods.name: handle_trp_information_request
methods.description: Schedules TRP information exchange procedures.

methods.name: handle_positioning_information_request
methods.description: Schedules positioning information exchange procedures.

methods.name: get_gnb_cu_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves gNB-CU UE F1AP ID for a given UE index or gNB-DU UE F1AP ID.

methods.name: get_gnb_du_ue_f1ap_id
methods.description: Retrieves gNB-DU UE F1AP ID for a given UE index or gNB-CU UE F1AP ID.

methods.name: get_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves UE index from gNB-DU or gNB-CU UE F1AP ID.

methods.name: handle_access_success
methods.description: Handles access success event, sending appropriate message.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs F1AP PDU details if logging is enabled.
